- Pushed commit f2ac984 to origin/master; local HEAD now matches upstream.
- Ran .ralph/task_switch.sh successfully; it refreshed current task summaries and sent the summary email.
- task_switch emitted the same non-fatal cleanup warning about missing .ralph/current_task.txt.
- Resume point if needed: worktree now contains fresh post-switch .ralph bookkeeping plus the pre-existing unstaged src/ha/decide.rs formatting change.

- Read prior progress and confirmed the repo has existing .ralph bookkeeping changes plus an unstaged src/ha/decide.rs change carried over from the previous run.
- Opened the improve-code-boundaries skill and started checking its found_smells workflow before selecting one boundary cleanup.
- Next: inspect found_smells and the relevant code, then implement one smell-driven refactor, lint/test, commit, push, and task switch.

- Selected src/command/mod.rs for improve-code-boundaries smell 10 because it has several small private helpers.
- Renamed authority_primary_member_label to wrong_helper_test_authority_primary_member_label and ran make check; compiler showed exactly one failing call site at src/command/mod.rs:250, proving it is a single-caller wrong helper.
- Next: revert the proof rename, inline the trivial projection into state_row, remove the helper, then rerun make check, make lint, and make test.

- Removed the single-caller wrong helper in src/command/mod.rs by inlining authoritative_primary_member(state).map(MemberId::as_str) directly into state_row.
- make check now passes after the refactor.
- Next: run the required make lint and make test gates, then commit/push including .ralph files and switch tasks.

- make lint passed.
- make test passed via cargo nextest with summary: 233 tests passed, 16 skipped, and nextest reported 5 leaky tests.
- Next: inspect git state, decide whether the leaky tests require an add-bug task per repo policy, then commit/push and switch tasks.

- Committed the smell-10 cleanup as 47eba65 (Inline command state primary label helper).
- Commit intentionally included src/command/mod.rs and the requested .ralph bookkeeping, and intentionally excluded the unrelated pre-existing src/ha/decide.rs formatting diff.
- Next: push master, then run .ralph/task_switch.sh and record its result.
